room.tower.title: Tower
room.tower.description: A round tower room with a cold [hearth](hearth) and a [sigil](sigil) cut into the floor.
detail.hearth: A hearth full of grey ash.
detail.sigil: A warding sigil, worn smooth by tracing fingers.
item.grimoire.room: A [grimoire] lies open on the floor.
item.grimoire.description: A grimoire in a cramped hand.
readable.grimoire: In the margin, underlined twice: noctis, the word that darkens.
quest.apprentice.title: The apprentice's sigil
narration.gather_ash: You scoop a pinch of ash from the hearth.
narration.trace_sigil: You trace the sigil; the word of warding settles in your mind.
narration.lux: The ash flares and a pale light hangs in the air.
narration.ward: A faint ward shimmers around you.
